Ava: Heads-up — final checklist for our Midwest Office Hours tomorrow. Quick sync on swag, lead routing, and speaker follow-ups please.
Diego: I can pick up the extra sticker packs from PrintCo at 9am. Do we have the SKU? :truck:
Priya: SKU for stickers is STK-RED-042. I updated the master inventory sheet.
Sam: For lead routing, we're using the badge scanner -> Zapier -> SFDC flow. Reminder: tag leads from 'product demo' vs 'dedicated' plans.
Ava: @Sam can you paste the Zap mapping here? Last time the tags got lost.
Sam: Sure. Zap steps (short): 1) Scanner POST -> 2) Formatter parse name,email,tag -> 3) Filter by tag -> 4) Create/Update Lead in SFDC with LeadSource=MidwestOH and Campaign=MW-Office-Hours
Sam: Formatter example payload: `{"name":"{{name}}","email":"{{email}}","interest":"demo|dedicated|private"}`
Diego: Vendor update: Swag vendor called — one tote batch delayed 24h. We still have 150 t-shirts + 200 stickers + 300 postcards.
Priya: Can we swap a limited run of sticker sheets into the speaker gift bag instead of totes? Speakers get premium enamel pin + notebook.
Evan: LogisticsBot: Scheduled delivery by PrintCo now shows ETA 08:30 tomorrow. Loading dock code will be shared at 07:45.
Ava: Good plan on speaker bags. @Priya order 12 enamel pins and 12 notebooks. Keep receipts in shared drive.
Priya: Ordered pins (PIN-ELM-12) and notebooks (NBK-RED-12). Invoice uploaded: drive.redwood/marketing/mw_oh/invoices
Diego: Booth layout for laptop demos — need 2 power strips, HDMI dongle kit, and a small sign that says "Try Redwood Inference: 1-min demo". Who's bringing signage?
Evan: I'll bring power strips and HDMI kit. Quick kit checklist:
```
- 2x 6-outlet strips
- 1x USB-C -> HDMI dongle
- 1x HDMI -> DisplayPort adaptor
- Extra charging cables
- Small tool kit
```
Sam: Lead triage rules: high-intent (request demo or enterprise keywords) -> assign to AE within 2 hours. Medium intent -> nurture via webinar invite. Low intent -> add to monthly newsletter cohort.
Ava: For webinar invites, use the 'MW Office Hours — Deep Dive' landing page. QR on postcard should prefill source=MW_OH and utm_campaign=officehours_mw
Priya: I designed a postcard QR with short link rvwd.ai/mwoh — QR generated and added to final art. Link redirects to prefill form.
Diego: One snag — vendor says postcard batch color may shift. Priya: can we approve a soft-proof? We need to avoid brand fade in the postcards.
Priya: Soft-proof uploaded. Approve by 6pm or we'll accept the vendor variant. @Ava please approve.
Ava: Approved. Also wording for booth pitch — 20s script. @Sam draft please.
Sam: Script options:
- 20s demo script: "Hey, we speed up LLM inference costs and latency. Want a 1-min demo?"
- 45s conversion: "We provide hosted, dedicated, and private inference with predictable costs and rollouts. Which do you use today?"
Diego: I'll run a 10-min speaker slot. Need slide deck and 2 slide leave-behinds for attendees. Who's prepping?
Ava: @Diego keep slides to 6. @Priya provide slide template. @Sam add benchmark callouts: tokens/sec, 99p latency, cost % savings.
Priya: Template uploaded to drive.redwood/marketing/mw_oh/assets. Benchmarks: add chart PNG `inference_bench_mw.png`
Evan: LogisticsBot: Reminder — booth staff arrival 07:00, load-in 07:30, badge pick-up at 07:45. Security check requires attendee list by 18:00 today.
Ava: I'll send final attendee list. One more thing — lead tags: use these exact values `demo`, `dedicated`, `private`, `pricing`, `partner`. No synonyms.
Sam: Noted. I'll add a Zap step to normalize tags to those canonical values.
Diego: Anyone able to bring a compact printer for on-site handouts? If not, I'll order print-at-venue.
Priya: I can bring compact printer but battery low — will charge overnight. Also bringing spare name badges.
Ava: Perfect. Thanks team — if nothing else, confirm by 20:00. :thumbsup:
